identity: A W/B graveyard-value midrange deck. It stocks its own graveyard on purpose (Eerie Soultender's ETB mill, Gibbering Barricade's repeatable sacrifice, Bone Splinters' additional cost, Liliana's symmetric discard) and then spends that yard three different ways: Sheoldred's Restoration and The Cruelty of Gix return a body to the battlefield, Serra Paragon rebuys the MV<=3 half every turn, and Monstrous War-Leech and Writhing Necromass read the yard directly off the cast side so no reanimation spell is needed at all. Elas il-Kor turns every creature that dies on the way there into direct damage, so filling the yard and building the clock are one action. It is deliberately built around LOW-mana-value reanimation targets, because Sheoldred's Restoration unkicked charges life equal to the returned card's mana value.

restrictions.extra_user_constraint: At most 5 rare-or-mythic cards total across mainboard + sideboard (rare LANDS count).

mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying

mainboard.name: The Cruelty of Gix
mainboard.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a creature or planeswalker card from it. That player discards that card.
II — Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle. You lose 3 life.
III — Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.

sideboard.name: Prayer of Binding
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flash
When this enchantment enters, exile up to one target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. You gain 2 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against artifacts (15 in cube) and noncreature permanents — the only nonland catch-all W/B has; flash makes it live against Vehicles and planeswalkers.

sideboard.name: Citizen's Arrest
sideboard.oracle_text: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against single large threats and bombs the removal suite misses (Silverback Elder, Defiler of Vigor, Sphinx of Clear Skies).

sideboard.name: Destroy Evil
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy target creature with toughness 4 or greater.
• Destroy target enchantment.
sideboard.when_to_board: Second copy in against the cube's 18 enchantments (Sagas, Citizen's Arrest, Leyline Binding) and toughness-4+ green fat.

sideboard.name: Knight of Dusk's Shadow
sideboard.oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Your opponents can't gain life.
{1}{B}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against the 22 lifegain cards — 'Your opponents can't gain life' blanks Mossbeard Ancient, Silverback Elder, Prayer of Binding and mirror-match kicked Sheoldred's Restoration.

sideboard.name: Choking Miasma
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {G} (You may pay an additional {G} as you cast this spell.)
If this spell was kicked, put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against wide token boards (Tokens is the cube's 2nd-largest cluster at 38 cards); 'All creatures get -2/-2' — board out Cult Conscript and Elas il-Kor when bringing it in. Cast unkicked for {1}{B}{B}; the {G} kicker is declined, so it needs no green source.

sideboard.name: Extinguish the Light
sideboard.oracle_text: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. If its mana value was 3 or less, you gain 3 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against planeswalkers and against creatures the mainboard's conditional removal misses — 'Destroy target creature or planeswalker' is the deck's only unconditional answer that costs no creature.

identity_es: Un midrange W/B de valor de cementerio. Abastece su propio cementerio a propósito (la molienda de entrada de Eerie Soultender, el sacrificio repetible de Gibbering Barricade, el coste adicional de Bone Splinters, el descarte simétrico de Liliana) y luego gasta ese cementerio de tres formas distintas: Sheoldred's Restoration y The Cruelty of Gix devuelven un cuerpo al campo de batalla, Serra Paragon recompra la mitad de MV<=3 cada turno, y Monstrous War-Leech y Writhing Necromass leen el cementerio directamente desde el lado del lanzamiento para que no haga falta hechizo de reanimación alguno. Elas il-Kor convierte cada criatura que muere por el camino en daño directo, así que llenar el cementerio y construir el reloj son una sola acción. Está deliberadamente construido alrededor de objetivos de reanimación de valor de maná BAJO, porque Sheoldred's Restoration sin kicker cobra vidas iguales al valor de maná de la carta devuelta.
